title: UsageBassoon configuration
description: Configuration file for the UsageBassoon CLI and Python library.

source_id.description: UUID namespace generated by `bassoon init`; reuse it only for environments that represent the same collection source.

backend.description: Storage backend to use. Use `duckdb` for local data persistence.

database.description: DuckDB file path, MotherDuck database name, or BigQuery dataset ID.

bin.description: Command prefix for running tokscale, including any runner arguments (for example, `npx tokscale@latest`, `bunx tokscale@latest`, or `deno x npm:tokscale@latest`). This setting overrides the `TOKSCALE_BIN` environment variable.

env.description: Additional parent environment-variable names intentionally copied into the tokscale subprocess. Values are read from the parent process; missing names are ignored. Credentials are never inherited automatically.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum duration of one tokscale subprocess invocation, additionally bounded by collection.cadence when configured.

max_stdout_bytes.description: Maximum tokscale stdout captured for one command. Output exceeding this limit terminates the subprocess.

max_stderr_bytes.description: Maximum tokscale stderr captured for one command. Output exceeding this limit terminates the subprocess.

location.description: BigQuery dataset and job location. Defaults to `US`.

credentials_file.description: Optional service-account credentials file path. When omitted, Google Application Default Credentials are used.

maximum_bytes_billed.description: Per-job maximum bytes billed for BigQuery queries, including user-facing relation queries.

uri.description: Google Cloud Storage snapshot archive URI.

project.description: Google Cloud project ID used by the Storage client.

location.description: Configured GCS bucket location metadata. Defaults to `US`.

credentials_file.description: Optional service-account credentials file path. When omitted, Google Application Default Credentials are used.

max_retries.description: Additional persistence attempts after the first failure.

cadence.description: Optional external collection cadence. When present, tokscale subprocesses share a deadline below this interval.

directory.description: Directory for active and rotated operational logs.

max_files.description: Number of retained log files, including the active file.

max_bytes.description: Maximum active log file size before rotation.

file_uri.description: Optional local path or `file://` snapshot archive URI. When omitted, the conventional local archive is used unless `gcs.uri` is configured.

interval.description: Optional positive snapshot cadence, such as `30m`, `12h`, or `7d`; units are seconds, minutes, hours, days, or weeks.
